segment.source: Simulate evolution with agents that search for food, reproduce and pass on mutating genes. Inspect individual agents and analyze population and gene distribution in charts.
segment.target: Simulirajte evolucijo z agenti, ki iščejo hrano, se razmnožujejo in prenašajo mutirajoče gene. Preglejte posamezne agente ter v grafikonih analizirajte porazdelitev populacije in genov.
